\/\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: inherit;\"\u003ELEFT HEART FAILURE VS RIGHT HEART FAILURE-\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb As a result, blood builds up in the pulmonary veins. This causes shortness of breath, trouble breathing or coughing – especially during physical activity. Left-sided heart failure is the most common type.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; font-size: 15.9991px;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: inherit;\"\u003ELeft sided heart failure occurs in people with-\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; This causes blood to build up in the veins (the blood vessels that carry blood from the organs and tissue back to the heart).
